applies_to: all three quick-follow-up TCP sender conditions in this run
declared_timing_boundary: immediately before the framed TCP request is sent through receipt and structural parsing of the complete correlated application acknowledgment
implemented_timing_start: time.monotonic_ns immediately before the framed TCP length prefix and application object are passed to sendall
implemented_timing_end: time.monotonic_ns immediately after the complete application acknowledgment has been received and parsed for exact frame length, magic, and protocol version
accepted_row_rule: A sender row is accepted only after every outside-timed comparison passes; the edge already validated the complete request payload length and CRC32 before emitting the acknowledgment.
result_interpretation: Use rtt_ms as monotonic complete-application-acknowledgment receipt-and-parse RTT. Do not interpret it as a TCP ACK RTT or one-way delay.
